name: reload-extension
description: 通过命令行按名称重新加载 Chrome 或 Edge 中的解压缩扩展。

scripts.clean: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:js: bun build src/cli.ts src/index.ts src/browser-worker.ts --outdir dist --target=node --format=esm --external playwright-core
scripts.build: bun run sync:playwright && bun run clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
